enabled.description: (#1279, B2): "1" or true judges the screen form of every turn of a person with a round: it reads the curator's judge context (`turns_ask` with `judge: true`), asks `./screen_model` once and sends the form as a second stamp `{turn_id, audience_set, screen_form}` out of the rim on `verdict` (the presenter's `in_verdict`). "0" (shipped): it hears the turn and sends nothing.

context_turns.description: GH #1279: how many earlier turns the judge context of the screen question carries (`turns_ask.n`); read only with `enabled` "1".

context_budget_tokens.description: GH #1279: the token budget of those turns (`turns_ask.budget_tokens`); hard cap 4000, 0 or less is 1500.

turns_ask.description: on `turns_ask`: `{n, budget_tokens, judge: true}` -- the read of the judge context in the curator's wall

system.description: on `screen_model`: the instructions of the screen question (`system.instructions`)

stamp.description: on `verdict`: the second stamp of the turn, `{turn_id, audience_set, screen_form}`, `screen_form` one of `active`, `accompanying`, `referring`, `none`

turn_id.description: the channel turn the judgement belongs to

state.description: on `turns_ask`: the turn's text, carried out and back through context, so this cell keeps no state

turns.description: on `in_turns`: the person's turns, unread here

state.description: on `in_turns`: the turn's text carried back

finish_reason.description: on `in_verdict`: the model's finish reason; anything but `stop` sends nothing

description.purpose: The screen judge of talky (#1279): the FORM the screen takes in a turn -- `active`, `accompanying`, `referring` or `none` -- judged by a model of its own beside the route stamp, which never waits for it. The form leaves as a second stamp of the same turn, on the rim's `verdict`, `{turn_id, audience_set, screen_form}`; the topic and the blocks stay the route stamp's (FU-0).
description.use_when: Inside talky, beside `./route` on the keeper's `turn`, switched on with `enabled` "1" where a screen reads the stamps (the presenter's `in_verdict`).
description.not_in_scope: No topic and no block: those are the decider's (`./route`, `judge_context`). No state: the turn's text rides out and back on the hop. No retry: an error, a refusal or an answer that is no form sends nothing, and the screen stays at its standard.
description.emits_meaning: turns_ask: the read of the judge context. screen_model: the one structured call of the turn. verdict: the second stamp, only a form, only for a turn with a round; talky carries it out on `verdict`, never on `stamp`.
description.consumes_meaning: `in_turn`: the keeper's turn. `in_turns`: the curator's judge context with the turn's text back on `hop.state`. `in_verdict`: `./screen_model`'s answer, a JSON object `{screen_form}`.
